description: Push a sprinted idea to Monnet as a private draft: brief.md becomes the idea's doc and the other files in the folder (reports, prototype, plans) are attached. Monnet then writes a review plan and replies; relay that reply to the person as it is. The tool reads the folder itself, so pass the path, not the content. Pushing the same folder again updates the same idea. Nothing is shared and nobody is notified until kick_off_idea. An older Monnet backend may not support push: the error then says so.

folder.description: Path to the sprint folder, the one that holds brief.md.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: push_idea
